title: Sheds
lead: Map-first shed hunting — species knowledge, private finds, GPS field workflow, and seasonal timing without trophy culture.
mission: For hunters and naturalists who want to read sign, learn cervid ecology, and keep find locations private.
principles: Support for deer, elk, moose, and other antler-shedding species
Empty-handed miles still count as useful field time

modules.title: Field map (whitetail)
modules.description: Interactive topographic map with private observations and relative search-priority guidance — never a map of antlers.

modules.title: Species browser
modules.description: Shed timing, habitat notes, and regional context for the animals you follow.

modules.title: Personal finds
modules.description: Private find records with notes and location privacy you control. Photos are not attached in the field map yet.

modules.title: Seasonal forecast
modules.description: Weather, snow, and timing signals that help you choose when to walk.

modules.title: Regulations guidance
modules.description: Clear jurisdiction notes with sources you can check.

modules.title: Trail camera notes
modules.description: Link camera evidence to your private finds when you want context.

dataModel: Your observations and notes stay on this device. Share only what you choose — nothing is posted by default.
